reviews.title: Quite possibly the easiest Case I have ever built in.
reviews.comment: This case is quite possibly the most builder friendly case I have ever worked with. Almost every single panel is removable; no need to fumble around the case attempting to attach fans, the chassis has completely detachable front, top and side panels. The Frame is quite sturdy, I don't feel a wobble or like its going to bend easily. It's also one of the few cases that are compatible with a 420 AIO and has the clearance for a gigantic tower cooler at the same time. If you want, you can also order a tempered glass side if you ever feel like you want to show off your components, but be aware that this will affect noise level and air flow if you do. It will also shave off a little bit of tower cooler compatibility. All in all, this is a case I would recommend in a heartbeat. It's incredibly easy to add extra fans, and it's cable management is great. Recommended for anyone using a high end GPU and CPU!
reviews.author: Carlos Canales

reviews.title: Great pc case!
reviews.comment: This is probably the best case I’ve ever built in. All black, no fluff, fantastic design for space, access, airflow, cable management paired with the Corsair 850x psu is awesome. I was looking for an all black no lights, power & usb’s on top & this fit the bill perfect! Price was good as well!
reviews.author: David Mayger

reviews.title: New pc use
reviews.comment: Ease of use is insane and the value has felt fantastic for its price. Highly recommend and it feels extremely solid with no chance of falling apart. No tempered glass in my purchase but looks very sleek!
reviews.author: Logan
